nodes.label: Dynamic Codec Resolution
nodes.rationale: Adapts codec choices to container compatibility while preserving the user's original Redux selection so switching containers back restores it.

nodes.label: Pure Functional Command Construction
nodes.rationale: Maps video settings to an ordered FFmpeg argument array without side effects or Redux mutations.

nodes.label: Rust Execution Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Runs FFmpeg and ffprobe as asynchronous native subprocesses using a typed argv array rather than a shell, with streamed logs, structured progress, and graceful cancellation.

nodes.label: Tool Manager and Binary Provisioning
nodes.rationale: Keeps installers lightweight by not bundling media binaries; resolves custom paths, managed application-data installs, then system PATH, and verifies downloaded builds with SHA-256.

nodes.label: Dynamic Codec Resolution
nodes.rationale: Normalizes codec choices to container compatibility and restores the original selection when switching back.

nodes.label: Native Rust Execution Engine
nodes.rationale: Executes subprocesses natively through Tauri v2, avoiding the prior Python sidecar and bundled FFmpeg binaries to reduce installer footprint.

nodes.label: First-Run Tool Manager
nodes.rationale: Detects system FFmpeg binaries or downloads verified static builds into application data; no binaries are bundled in the installer.
